title: Kūpuna cited after unlicensed contractor work
summary: As of September 8, the office is helping an older woman cited for an unpermitted home addition, and an architectural firm has agreed to help her address the notices of violation. She built the addition after relying on an unlicensed contractor, and she has no email address, which is needed to get a building permit. The firm says it has seen other older adults taken advantage of and then cited.
